content:
Procurement on Sponsored Awards Knowledge Review

From the ORA eTraining module "Purchasing with Purpose: Procurement on Sponsored Projects" (lesson 14 of 15).
incorrect
Your department is in need of graphic design work for an annual report detailing your program's accomplishments. After the work is done the vendor provides you with the following invoice. What error(s) will need to be rectified before submitting this invoice for processing through MSU's Accounts Payable department? Select all that apply.
The invoice number should begin with "MSU".
The "Bill To" address should be Morgan State University with attention to Dr. May.
Tax charges must be removed.
The description of services is too vague.
Great job!
One of your selections is not a requirement on invoices.
You are trying to book travel for a faculty member on your budget. You check various sources and find that Orbitz.com has the best price for your hotel stay. When you try to book the stay you receive an error message stating payment couldn't be processed. What might be the reason(s) why? Select all that apply.
Your project budget doesn't have a travel (04) budget.
Orbitz.com may have an MCC code block by the State of Maryland.
You are over your monthly spending limit for your p-card.
US Bank has flagged the expense as part of their potential fraud protection.
Great Job! It is good practice to be aware of these possible obstacles so you can use other resources if necessary.
Remember that you can technically process allowable purchases without an available budget in the appropriate budget pool.
Assume you are working on your April P-Card expenses. Put these dates in order of occurrence in the P-Card cycle. *Drag the correct response on the left to the corresponding date on the right.
Statement Close Date
4/25
Statement Availability Date
4/26
BANNER Reconciliation Date
5/8
State Transaction Log Due Date
5/15
freezeFirst
Match each procurement range with the appropriate competition requirement.
$0 - $5,000
No formal competition required; price must still be reasonable.
$5,001 - $25,000
Three vendors consulted; informal quotes acceptable.
$25,001 - $100,000
Three vendors consulted; typically requires an RFQ and Performance Work Statement.
Greater than $100,000
Formal RFP process with eMMA posting and proposal review committee
Match the activity to the responsible office.
Vendor Invoice Payment
Accounts Payable
Equipment Tagging
Property Control
Vendor Registration
Procurement
Working Fund Check Pickup
Office of the Bursar
Banner Workflow Access
Office of the Comptroller
Knowledge check: To submit your log through DocuSign you need all of the following except:
  - a copy of your US Bank statement  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - detailed invoices for each expense  [incorrect]
  - completed State of Maryland Transaction Log  [incorrect]
  - a screenshot of the budget(s) funding the expense  [incorrect]
  If correct: Great job!
  If incorrect: Try again.
Knowledge check: Which of the following Banner page codes is used for p-card reconciliation?
  - FGIENCD  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - FGIBDST  [incorrect]
  - FRIGITD  [incorrect]
  - FAAINVT  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  If correct: Great job!
  If incorrect: Try again.
Knowledge check: Dr. Cage, a cardholder in the Biology department, needs to purchase lab supplies from a major lab supply company. After totaling the items needed the quote came out to $5,100. Dr. Cage decides to request two quotes from the vendor for $2,500 and $2,600. What banner purchasing practice is Dr. Cage guilty of performing?
  - fraud  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - split purchasing  [incorrect]
  - utilizing an unregistered vendor  [incorrect]
  - providing kickbacks  [incorrect]
  If correct: Great job!
  If incorrect: Try again.
Knowledge check: Which Uniform Guidance principle asks whether a purchase is permitted under the award, federal regulations, sponsor terms, and institutional policy?
  - Allocability  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - Reasonableness  [incorrect]
  - Allowability  [incorrect]
  - Consistency  [incorrect]
  If correct: Great job! Allowability determines whether the cost is permitted under applicable rules.
  If incorrect: Try again.
  Note on "Allocability": Try again.
Knowledge check: Why are purchases made near the end of a project period closely scrutinized?
  - They require sponsor approval.  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - They must clearly benefit the remaining project period.  [incorrect]
  - They are never allowable.  [incorrect]
  - They require VP for Finance and Management approval.  [incorrect]
  If correct: Great job! This raises red flags with respect to cost allocability.
  If incorrect: Try again.
Knowledge check: A $4,000 laboratory supply purchase is planned. What level of competition is required?
  - Three written quotes  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - Formal RFQ  [incorrect]
  - One quote/no formal competition  [incorrect]
  - Two quotes  [incorrect]
  If correct: Great job!
  If incorrect: Try again.
Knowledge check: For a procurement between $25,001 and $100,000, what document establishes the scope of work?
  - Purchase Order (PO)  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - Internal Routing Form (IRF)  [incorrect]
  - Performance Work Statement (PWS)  [incorrect]
  - Invoice  [incorrect]
  If correct: Great job!
  If incorrect: Try again.
Knowledge check: After an RFQ has been posted, what should the initiator do if a vendor has questions?
  - Answer them directly  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - Ignore them  [incorrect]
  - Refer them to Procurement  [incorrect]
  - Cancel the procurement  [incorrect]
  If correct: Great job!
  If incorrect: Try again.
Knowledge check: A vendor has never done business with Morgan. Before a requisition can proceed, what is generally required?
  - Cost Transfer Request Form  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - Vendor Registration Form  [incorrect]
  - Sole Source Determination Form  [incorrect]
  - Non-Travel Reimbursement Form  [incorrect]
  If correct: Great job!
  If incorrect: Try again.
Knowledge check: To authorize an invoice for payment, it should be marked:
  - Approved  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - Paid  [incorrect]
  - Verified  [incorrect]
  - OK to Pay  [incorrect]
  If correct: Great job!
  If incorrect: Try again.
Knowledge check: Which statement best describes a subaward?
  - Purchase of routine lab supplies  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - An outside entity performs substantive programmatic work  [incorrect]
  - Payment for consulting services only  [incorrect]
  - Purchase of equipment  [incorrect]
  If correct: Great job!
  If incorrect: Try again.
Knowledge check: When Morgan is the prime recipient, indirect costs are generally assessed on what portion of a subaward?
  - Entire amount  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - No IDC is charged  [incorrect]
  - First $25,000  [incorrect]
  - First $50,000  [incorrect]
  Note on "Entire amount": Try again.
  Note on "No IDC is charged": Try again.
  Note on "First $25,000": Great job!
  Note on "First $50,000": Try again. This is the federal threshold, but not Morgan's.
Knowledge check: What is the primary purpose of the MSU Working Fund on sponsored projects?
  - Purchase equipment  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - Pay travel advances  [incorrect]
  - Provide participant incentives  [incorrect]
  - Purchase office supplies  [incorrect]
  If correct: Great job!
  If incorrect: Try again.
Knowledge check: Before entering a requisition in Banner, which of the following should be confirmed? Select the best answer.
  - The vendor has a completed invoice ready.  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - Workflow access, availability of funds, vendor setup, and any required Statement of Work.  [incorrect]
  - The Office of Research Administration has pre-approved the cost.  [incorrect]
  - Accounts Payable has approved the transaction.  [incorrect]
  If correct: Great job!
  If incorrect: Try again.
Knowledge check: After obtaining a requisition number for a Sodexo catering order, which should you do next?
  - Wait for an email from the MSU Events Office.  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - Send the requisition number to the MSU Events Office.  [incorrect]
  - Submit the catering invoice to Accounts Payable.  [incorrect]
  - Contact the sponsor for final approval.  [incorrect]
  If correct: Great job!
  If incorrect: Try again.
Knowledge check: A faculty member pays for grant supplies out of pocket and submits a non-travel reimbursement request. The receipt includes Maryland sales tax. What should happen?
  - Reimburse the full amount, including tax.  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - Reimburse only the pre-tax amount.  [incorrect]
  - Charge the tax to indirect costs.  [incorrect]
  - Submit a cost transfer.  [incorrect]
  If correct: Great job!
  If incorrect: Try again.
